subject: Mid-cycle capacity activation & invoice hold — VAT ID needed
content:
From: Eleni Kostas <eleni.kostas@novamed.eu>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamed Billing <billing@novamed.eu>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:12:00 +0200
Subject: Mid-cycle activation of extra capacity (PO attached) — please hold collection

Hi Laura,

Quick note from Novamed finance — we activated 4 additional dedicated GPUs on 2026-08-03 as part of our capacity burst (order referenced in PO attached). I see an automated charge hit our account for the full month. We expected a prorated charge effective 8/3 and a corrected invoice with EU reverse-charge VAT notation (our VAT ID below).

Can you please:
- Place a hold on collection for this charge until we receive the corrected invoice (we need the reverse-charge wording for our AP team).
- Reissue an adjusted invoice reflecting the prorated amount from 8/03–8/31 and zero VAT with reverse-charge reference.

Novamed VAT ID: EU123456789
Attachment: purchase-order_9876.pdf (PO for the upgrade)
Attachment: signed-mop-update.pdf (signed amendment)

This is for deal NW-2026-045. Our AP team needs the final invoice to release payment; can we get a reissued invoice by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks — Eleni
Eleni Kostas
Head of Finance, Novamed
eleni.kostas@novamed.eu

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Eleni Kostas <eleni.kostas@novamed.eu>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 17:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle activation of extra capacity (PO attached) — please hold collection

Hi Eleni — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the PO and signed MOP.

We will not proceed with collection while we validate the VAT reverse-charge and finalize the proration math. Stephanie, Marcus — looping you in to take ownership of the corrected invoice and apply a temporary collection hold.

Eleni — two quick asks so we can move fast:
1) Please confirm the AP contact (name + AP email) who should receive the corrected invoice.
2) Confirm the VAT ID in writing (you included it in the message, but our billing flow requires it inside the PO or a quick confirmation line).

Preliminary plan: Marcus will compute the prorated credit for the August activation, Stephanie will hold the charge and reissue an adjusted invoice with the EU reverse-charge wording. Once Novamed confirms AP email, we will send the corrected invoice and the credit memo.

I’ll aim to have a reissued invoice ready within 24 hours after your confirmation.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:14:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle activation of extra capacity (PO attached) — proration calc attached

Following up with the proration calc and next steps. Draft numbers below — please treat as preliminary until we confirm the PO/VAT ID. I attached a one-page spreadsheet (calc excerpt) to the internal thread.

Summary (provisional):
- Capacity: +4 GPUs, activated 2026-08-03 (billing cycle month = Aug 1–31)
- Full-month list price per GPU: EUR 3,200
- Daily rate per GPU = 3,200 / 31 = EUR 103.23
- Days billed for activation (8/03–8/31) = 29 days
- Charge for added GPUs = 4 * 103.23 * 29 = EUR 11,967.72
- If automated charge was for a full month (4 * 3,200 = EUR 12,800), credit to issue = EUR 12,800 - 11,967.72 = EUR 832.28

Action items:
- Stephanie: place collection hold on original automated charge, generate credit memo for EUR 832.28, and reissue invoice showing net amount EUR 11,967.72 with EU reverse-charge note and Novamed VAT ID.
- Laura: confirm AP contact for delivery.

DocuSign note: we have the signed MOP in the thread; if billing needs a signed amendment as a link, use https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-mop-amend

— Marcus
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

---

From: Eleni Kostas <eleni.kostas@novamed.eu>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamed Billing <billing@novamed.eu>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 11:27:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle activation of extra capacity (PO attached) — please hold collection

Laura / Marcus / Stephanie —

Thanks, confirmed: AP contact is:
Maria Ioannou <m.ioannou@novamed.eu>, Accounts Payable Manager
Novamed confirms VAT ID EU123456789 (also shown on PO). PO attached again for clarity.

We appreciate you holding collection while you reissue the invoice. If you can send the corrected invoice and credit memo to m.ioannou@novamed.eu and billing@novamed.eu, we’ll process within our next payment run once they see the reverse-charge notation.

Best,
Eleni

Attachment: purchase-order_9876.pdf

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: billing@redwood.ai
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 11:03:00 +0200
Subject: Fwd: Mid-cycle activation of extra capacity (PO attached) — reissue & hold request

Forwarding Novamed thread — please apply the following: 1) Place a temporary hold on collection for the automated charge posted 2026-08-03 (do not auto-capture). 2) Issue credit memo for EUR 832.28. 3) Reissue invoice for EUR 11,967.72, include EU reverse-charge text and Novamed VAT ID EU123456789. 4) Send corrected invoice + credit memo to m.ioannou@novamed.eu and billing@novamed.eu.

Please reply-all when complete so I can close the loop with Novamed.

Thanks — Laura

[Internal note to billing: Do not trigger dunning while hold is active. Reference deal NW-2026-045. Attach signed-mop-update.pdf and purchase-order_9876.pdf to the reissued invoice email.]
